source.analyses: experiments/synthetic_trainers: paper_phases.diagnose, persistence.assess (without its embedded phases) and stability_recovery.describe, under PersistenceConfig() and 10000-update windows
source.fields: Each archived case keeps the train and held-out accuracy and the cumulative seconds of every canonical observation, in columns; the reduction changes no output. `persistent` and `unfinished` are derived from `grokking` and `unstable` as their sources say.

persistent.source: grokking, every observation from its held-out onset on at accuracy 1

unfinished.source: unstable, through update 100000 of its budget
